A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Unisoma study and contain readable text, equations, figures, tables, and complete Appendices A–G. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that the appendices are identical.

before.justification: v1 reports original prediction and simulation experiments, efficiency measurements, ablations, and out-of-distribution evaluations in Section 4 and Appendices F–G.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including benchmark comparisons, efficiency measurements, ablations, and out-of-distribution evaluations.

M1.justification: The encoder, contact modules, adaptive interaction allocation, deformation modules, and decoder remain unchanged in Section 3 and Appendix A. The wording edit before Equation 7 does not alter the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same seven datasets, long-time prediction and autoregressive simulation tasks, and material-parameter distribution-shift scenario. Table 1 and Appendix D are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in every corresponding experiment. Table 4 changes the proposed method's label from UNISOL to UNISOMA; this is a naming correction, not a different comparator.

E3.justification: Data splits, metrics, preprocessing, training configurations, rollout procedures, and efficiency measurement settings are unchanged in Section 4 and Appendices C–E.

E4.justification: The mesh-edge and load ablations in Appendix F, material-shift evaluations in Appendix G, and error-map examples in Figure 4 are identical.

E5.justification: Both versions report three experimental repetitions in Section 4.1 and Appendix E and retain identical uncertainty reporting in Table 4. No statistical reporting procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical results, rankings, and qualitative findings are retained. The renamed Table 4 row has identical values, including Cavity Grasping RMSE-all of 9.50 ± 0.54 in units of 10^-3.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, equations, and slice-composition/decomposition derivations in Appendix B are unchanged. Minor spacing differences around Equation 6 do not change its mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about explicit modeling, flexibility across multi-solid systems, predictive performance, generalization, and efficiency.

C2.justification: The interpretations of explicit modeling, generalization, computational efficiency, and edge sensitivity remain unchanged, as do the baseline implementation qualifications in Appendix E.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, preprocessing instructions, and code-access information are unchanged, including Appendix E and Tables 7 and 10.

R1.justification: Section 2, the cited works, and the positioning of explicit modeling relative to existing approaches are unchanged.

P1.justification: Before Equation 7, 'deformation interaction,' becomes 'deformation interaction as follows:'. Table 4 corrects UNISOL to UNISOMA, and the arXiv version/date stamp changes. Section organization and remaining prose are unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 4's method label is corrected, with small local spacing and typesetting adjustments on pages 6 and 8. Figures, captions, table organization, and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: Correcting UNISOL to UNISOMA in Table 4 makes the result attribution consistent with the paper, while the edit before Equation 7 slightly improves sentence flow. These are limited editorial improvements; the scientific content, empirical evidence, and reproducibility information remain unchanged.
